inquiryPhotos.title: Optional photos

inquiryPhotos.permission: I declare that I can share this photo for assessment of this inquiry.
inquiryPhotos.upload_incomplete: Upload is not confirmed. Select the same photo to try again.

inquiryPhotos.held: Held privately and unavailable for review. Contact the team.
inquiryPhotos.unavailable: Photos cannot be attached here. Contact the team; your inquiry already exists.
